mechanism.claim: A weekly tightening or easing in the Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index is a broad external risk-state change. After the release is certainly public and when BTC variation is elevated, tightening maps short BTC and easing maps long BTC over the weekend liquidity interval.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of causal week-over-week NFCI change
mechanism.why_distinct: NFCI jointly summarizes money, debt, equity, and banking conditions. Existing Treasury, SOFR, dollar, Cboe, Fed-balance-sheet, FX, and crypto-native candidates use narrower objects and no repository alpha uses causal ALFRED NFCI vintages.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the weekly release is traded only when completed BTC variation is in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one Friday 00:05 UTC macro-financial weekend clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: ALFRED real-time vintages of Chicago Fed NFCI
features.causal_vintage: next Friday W+7 calendar days, after normal Wednesday and holiday-shifted Thursday release
features.observation: NFCI value for W read from only the W+7 ALFRED vintage
features.change: causal NFCI[W]-causal NFCI[W-7], strict nonzero; each term independently from its own next-Friday vintage
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over seven UTC days ending at decision W+7 00:00)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 156 source-valid weekly decisions, minimum 104, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: weekly nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.one_week_stale_nfci: prior NFCI change with current variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, vintage, delay, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
